dynamic_line.//~: Have you seen our big stompy quads?  There's a lot of things we're good at, but sneaky and subtle we aren't.  If we want a meet cute, first we've got to lay out the hempen mats.
dynamic_line.str: Hat ye kennt our great clanks an' stompers?  There be many a thing we can do right good, but for the supple an' smooth, we b'ain't.  Wish'n we to make a meet-cute, must we first lay out the hempen mats.

responses.text: Hold up, did you just say "meet cute"?
I am guessing it doesn't matter, but what do you mean about hempen mats?
OK, fine.  Tell me more about this job that you can't do.
